questions.q: Which length is the proper length in Lorentz contraction?
options: Length measured in the object's rest frame
Length measured only by a moving observer
Every object's diameter in any frame
questions.explanation: Proper length L₀ is measured when the object is at rest; its length parallel to relative motion is L=L₀/γ.
questions.explanation_bn: বস্তু যে কাঠামোতে স্থির সেখানে L₀; আপেক্ষিক গতির সমান্তরাল দৈর্ঘ্য L=L₀/γ।
